description: Start a large CSV report (no size limit, unlike the synchronous reports). Returns a report_run_id; check it with snap_report_async_status, then snap_report_async_download. Read-only.

breakdown.description: How to split the table: by ad squad or by ad.

end_time.description: A day (YYYY-MM-DD: the whole day is included, so it means the start of the next day in SNAP_REPORT_UTC_OFFSET) or an ISO date-time on the hour with an offset, such as 2026-10-20T00:00:00+03:00 (Snap needs whole hours).

entity.description: What to act on: campaign, adsquad or ad (ad squads are Snapchat's ad sets).

id.description: Id of the item named by entity. Get it from snap_list_campaigns, snap_list_adsquads or snap_list_ads.

start_time.description: A day (YYYY-MM-DD: the start of that day in SNAP_REPORT_UTC_OFFSET) or an ISO date-time on the hour with an offset, such as 2026-10-19T00:00:00+03:00 (Snap needs whole hours).

name: snap_report_async_start
